name: KUKA
description: KUKA AG is an industrial automation and robotics manufacturer headquartered in Augsburg, Germany. In healthcare, KUKA produces the 7-axis [LBR Med](/robot/kuka_lbr_med) collaborative robot arm—integrated as an OEM manipulator by [eCential Robotics](/company/ecential_robotics), [ROPCA](/company/ropca) ([ARTHUR](/robot/ropca_arthur)), and [Andromeda Surgical](/company/andromeda_surgical) ([Beacon](/robot/andromeda_beacon))—as well as the high-payload 6-axis [KR QUANTEC HC](/robot/kuka_kr_quantec_hc) arm used in [Accuray](/company/accuray)'s [CyberKnife](/robot/accuray_cyberknife) radiosurgery system.
